target_questions.question: How do droplet diameter and prevaporized fraction bound fuel survival, detonated fraction, and wave speed?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 D009 links evaporation length to wave stability; this study adds hydrogen-assisted, partially prevaporized n-heptane.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: In the two-dimensional RDC model, n-heptane droplet diameter and prevaporized fraction control whether droplets survive beyond the refill zone, the detonated fuel fraction, and a 5-30% detonation-speed deficit, with a non-monotonic minimum near the reported critical diameter.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: The Eulerian-Lagrangian study classifies droplet trajectories by evaporation/residence time and wave-structure interaction under hydrogen addition.

limitations: Simplified two-dimensional chemistry/flow model; the reported critical diameter is case-specific.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
